name: Erlebnisberg Achensee
kurzbeschreibung: The **Erlebnisberg Achensee** offers a **Sommerrodelbahn**, archery, a **Kletterpark**, and plenty of activities for the whole family.
beschreibung: Achensee Adventure Mountain – Achensee Adventure Mountain delivers both thrills and relaxation, making it the perfect destination for a varied day out. Here, you’ll find a summer toboggan run, archery, a climbing park, and plenty of activities for the whole family. After an action-packed day, the wellness area beckons with saunas, rest zones, and massage treatments. The mix of physical activity followed by relaxation ensures a perfectly balanced experience. Nestled in the stunning mountain landscape of the **Achensee** region, Achensee Adventure Mountain offers not only exciting challenges but also breathtaking views. Families with children will also find plenty to explore and enjoy. The combination of impressive scenery and warm hospitality makes a visit here truly unforgettable.
